meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容自动整理成需求文档并提交到项目跟踪系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们在讨论中确定了需求，需要快速生成规范文档并同步到项目管理系统
copy.tagline_en: Turn your conversation into a spec and publish it to the project tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn discussions into structured specs and push them to your issue tracker

howto.what: Claude 会根据当前对话和代码库理解，自动生成一份功能规格文档（PRD），并发布到项目的问题跟踪器中，同时打上“ready-for-agent”标签。
howto.when: 当你与 Claude 讨论完某个功能需求后，直接要求它“把讨论内容写成规格”时触发。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的登录功能写成规格文档。
say.note: Claude 会生成并发布规格。

say.text: 将我们聊的搜索优化方案整理成 PRD 并提交。
say.note: Claude 会生成并发布规格。

howto.what_en: Claude synthesizes the current conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (PRD) and publishes it to the project issue tracker with a 'ready-for-agent' label.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to turn the discussed feature into a spec after a conversation.

say_en.text: Turn the login feature we just discussed into a spec.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and publish the spec.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for the search optimization plan we talked about and submit it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and publish the spec.
